metric: mean of 57 coordinatewise RMSE values over frames, in cm

qat.execution: parallel branch from frozen validation-selected intermediate FP32 checkpoint; FP32 continuation proceeds independently

test_policy: Evaluate only after validation-selected FP32 and QAT checkpoints are frozen; no test-driven tuning

published_reference.fp32_pwl_scope: Paper says PWL is applied at inference but Table4 does not explicitly bind the FP32 7.85cm number to specific nonlinearities; report both local FP32 paths.
published_reference.quantization_method_comparison: Local 8.8135 cm uses QAT with weight updates; eMamba 8.83 cm uses PTQ. Numerical proximity is not a reproduction or an equivalent-method comparison.

hardware_scope: New weights/scales are software exports; existing RTL ROMs and physical results retain their original weights.

recovery.validation: Dataset, checkpoint pairing and QAT code hashes checked before resume; no source or profile change.

fp32_refinement.objective: mean(sqrt(mean((prediction-label)**2, dim=0)+1e-8)) per training minibatch; full validation uses unsmoothed established metric
fp32_refinement.selection: Compare MSE continuation and one RMSE refinement candidate on validation only, before final test evaluation.

fp32_pwl_refinement.selection: PWL forward validation RMSE, including epoch0 fallback; no test tuning
fp32_pwl_refinement.purpose: Reduce approximation error with same PWL functions and model architecture; report PWL FP32 separately from exact-function FP32.

selection.criterion: Minimum full-validation mean coordinatewise RMSE within the intended forward mode
